Ghana's Finance Minister presents the 2027 Budget to Parliament on 12 November 2026.
This tracker measures it against the 2026 budget, what was actually spent in 2026, and
what the 2026 budget itself planned for 2027. Until the budget is out it shows that
baseline. [Open it full screen](/dashboards/budget-2027-app/index.html) if the frame is cramped.

The sector briefs are drafted with AI help from the budget documents and checked figure by
figure against the source PDF before publishing. Data: Ministry of Finance (budget
statements, fiscal data and fiscal newsletters), IMF. Source code:
[github.com/aappiah17](https://github.com/aappiah17).
